prompt: A panel member avoiding soy sees an orange dot on cup MB. What should the score sheet show?
promptZh: 一位不吃大豆的小組成員在 MB 杯上看到橘色圓點。評分表應如何填？

options.text: A zero for MB and no entries for the other drinks
options.zh: MB 填零分，其餘飲料都不填
options.whyZh: 未試飲不等於零分；其他可試飲的飲料仍可照常評分。

options.text: The product name instead of MB, followed by a score
options.zh: 用品名取代 MB，後面填分數
options.whyZh: 評分只用代碼，且須跳過含大豆的 MB。

options.text: “Not tasted” for MB, while the other drinks can still receive scores
options.zh: MB 標「未試飲」，其餘飲料仍可評分
options.whyZh: 橘點表示含大豆，須跳過 MB 並註記；不是取消整場試飲。

options.text: A request for a fresh MB cup before the member records any scores
options.zh: 要求換一杯 MB，再開始打分
options.whyZh: 換杯是用於杯貼掉落；同代碼的樣品仍含大豆。

explanationZh: 橘點表示含大豆，須跳過 MB 並註記；不是取消整場試飲。
evidence: The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring. | An orange dot on a sticker means the drink contains soy. Panel members avoiding soy should skip that sample but can score the others. Mark “not tasted” for any skipped cup; do not enter a numeric score.

vocabulary.note: 表示未品嚐，因此不填分數。
